---
title: Spend effort in proportion to what the outcome reaches
---

Scale what you read and re-check to how far the result reaches, never the evidence a claim rests on.

Judge the reach before starting: how many things the result changes, who can
observe them, and what the claims will have to rest on.

Two things never scale down. The evidence a claim rests on is one; what you
disclose about limits is the other.
